comment: Pinned upstream libraries: CC0, and since D-391 CC BY 3.0 / 4.0 with the attribution line, licence URI and statement of changes the licence asks for (owner decision 28 Oct 2026, D-193; D-391). Audio and LICENSE are taken from audio_commit; SFZ mappings from mapping_commit. A referenced sample must have the same git blob id at both commits or the build fails. Paths matching any 'exclude' pattern are fatal unless listed in 'allow' with a reason. VCSL: the Yamaha upright is not used because its samples on the sfz branch (a commit without a LICENSE file) differ from master (D-195).

libraries.title: VS Chamber Orchestra 2: Community Edition
libraries.publisher: Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner, Simon Dalzell; sample cutting Elan Hickler / Soundemote)

libraries.title: Virtuosity Drums
libraries.publisher: Versilian Studios; performed by Austin McMahon; recorded at Virtuosity Musical Instruments, Boston

libraries.title: Salamander Grand Piano V3
libraries.publisher: Alexander Holm (recording); SFZ remap by kinwie (sfzinstruments)
libraries.attribution: "Salamander Grand Piano V3" by Alexander Holm (https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3), SFZ remap by kinwie (https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano).
libraries.modifications: samples converted to FLAC, loudness-normalised and trimmed; the SFZ mapping converted to KIF with the natural tuning only; hammer-noise and string-resonance release samples kept, pedal noise omitted.

libraries.title: Greg Sullivan's E-Pianos
libraries.publisher: Greg Sullivan (recording); SFZ mapping by kinwie (sfzinstruments)
libraries.attribution: "Greg Sullivan's E-Pianos" (electric grand, pad-plucked and reed electric pianos) by Greg Sullivan (http://www.sullivang.net/), SFZ mapping by kinwie (https://github.com/sfzinstruments/GregSullivan.E-Pianos).
libraries.modifications: samples converted to FLAC, loudness-normalised and trimmed; the SFZ mappings converted to KIF; instrument names changed to descriptive, brand-free names.
